response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with nearly 20 years of software development and some high-throughput systems exposure, but he falls well short of the role's core requirements: his C++ experience amounts to roughly seven months plus a thesis project (vs. 8 years required), his career centers on web/product engineering in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than cloud compute platforms, and he lacks demonstrated formal technical leadership mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers at scale.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (~19 years) across web, backend, and systems programming
Real low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic (millions of HTTP requests/sec)
Strong engineering-culture credentials: TDD, CI/CD, open-source authorship, workshops, and mentoring via talks and dojos
concerns: C++ experience (~7 months professionally) is far below the 8-year minimum requirement
No dedicated cloud compute platform or large-scale infrastructure ownership; background is mostly product/web engineering
No formal technical-lead role with responsibility for cross-team strategy, priorities, and deliverables

key_factors.factor: Distributed systems and mentoring track record
